page.noAiBody: A device not on that list earns it by asking: the first time one requests face data it is remembered, which is how the newer YumShare models are recognised despite sharing a codename with older ones that have no camera AI.

status.recognitionOff: Recognition is off on its devices

import.title: Import pets from your PetKit account?
import.body: This asks PetKit which pets the device recognises and downloads their reference photos. Each arrives as a new pet with PetKit's id bound to it, so events the device already recorded under that id get named too.
import.naming: Imported pets are called “PetKit pet” and a number: the name is not in the data a device receives, so rename them afterwards. Nothing is sent until you press Import.
import.asking: Asking PetKit and fetching the photos…
import.skipped_one: {{count}} pet not added: the box already recognises the most cats it can hold.
import.skipped_other: {{count}} pets not added: the box already recognises the most cats it can hold.
import.nothingNew: Nothing new: PetKit lists no pets this device does not already have.

recognition.title: On-device recognition
recognition.aside: What each device's camera matches against
recognition.cacheEmpty: No face photos cached on the device yet. It re-reads them at boot and about once an hour; a reboot forces it.
recognition.cachedOurs: Cached on device: {{photos}} <ids>{{ids}}</ids>. They are yours, so it matches against your photos.
recognition.cachedForeign: Cached on device: {{photos}} <ids>{{ids}}</ids>. Not yours: it is still using photos from PetKit's cloud. Turn proxy mode off and reboot the device to switch it to your {{ours}}.
recognition.detectionNote: Yowling, urine pH and the other detection switches are on the Devices page.

unbound.title: Unbound identities
unbound.intro: Your device reported these pet ids, but they are not yours: it is still matching against faces cached from PetKit's cloud. Bind one to a pet to name its past events. Once the device picks up your own photos it reports your ids instead, and this list empties.
unbound.loadFailed: Could not load the unbound identities. {{error}}
